option.name: originalContent
option.value:
#!/bin/bash
echo "=== Checking OpenTelemetry Collector Logs ===" echo "Looking for metric data in collector logs..." podman logs otel-collector --tail=50 | grep -E "(metric|batch|debug)" || echo "No recent metric logs found"
echo "" echo "=== Checking Collector Container Status ===" podman ps | grep otel-collector
echo "" echo "=== Checking Prometheus Metrics Endpoint ===" echo "Fetching metrics from collector's Prometheus endpoint..." curl -s http://localhost:8889/metrics | head -20
echo "" echo "=== Checking if your demo metrics are present ===" echo "Looking for your demo metrics..." curl -s http://localhost:8889/metrics | grep -E "(demo_requests_total|demo_memory_usage|demo_response_time)" || echo "Demo metrics not found"
